en.t: The poem was written on a slip of paper.
When the old nun read it, she was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 她眼看见今日这盛况，回思当年在明石浦上送别源氏公子时情状，以及女御诞生时模样，

en.t: Seeing the splendor of this day before her eyes, she thought back to the scene years ago when she had seen Prince Genji off at Akashi Bay, and to the circumstances of the Consort's birth,

units.source_text: 觉得自己三生有幸，感激不尽！

en.t: and felt that she must have been blessed through three lifetimes, filled with endless gratitude.

units.source_text: 而想起了遁世入山的明石道人，又觉十分挂念，心中无限悲伤！

en.t: But when she thought of the Akashi monk, who had renounced the world and gone into the mountains, she felt deeply anxious for him, and boundless sorrow filled her heart.

units.source_text: 但今日不宜说出不吉之言，故答诗云：

en.t: Yet on this day it was not fitting to speak inauspicious words, so she answered with this poem:
